capture_method.readback: User profile loaded in a logged-in RunningCheeseChrome browser (huashu-chrome CDP bridge). Browser was not running at task start; launched D:/Program Files (x86)/RunningCheeseChrome/App/chrome.exe, bridge recovered after retry. Profile tab was RELOADED before extraction to defeat cache (historical pitfall: cached view showed stale 261123). Reloaded DOM exposed newest ranking note 261125 with cover signature 202611261117; card metadata extracted from section.note-item.
capture_method.ocr_preprocessing: cover upscaled 3x with ffmpeg lanczos (640x327 -> 1920x981), then cropped into left/right halves and per-row/per-field slices at 2x-10x for glyph disambiguation
capture_method.ocr_uncertainty_note: Book/author names transcribed from a low-resolution embedded table. Ambiguous glyphs flagged medium with per-item ocr_notes (圆/园, 黏/粘, 妩/妖, 道/导, 橘). No glyph resolved by guessing. Cross-day consistency with 261124 used only as corroboration, never as a substitute for what is visible in this cover. Odd semantic labels (大结果, 坏好参半性转嫌疑) transcribed verbatim as printed.
capture_method.danping_column_absent: This cover has only 7 columns (排名/发表时间/标签题材/书名/作者名/喜欢/评论现状); there is NO 弹评 column. Schema requires danping, so danping is left as empty string for all rows — NOT an OCR omission, NOT zero, NOT fabricated. Same as the 261123/261124 covers.

parsing.ranking_scope: single screenshot of one daily ranking table; not the full platform ranking
parsing.column_semantics_note: likes is the numeric count as printed under '喜欢'; danping is empty because the source cover has no 弹评 column (see capture_method.danping_column_absent); comment_status is a qualitative label under '评论现状'.
parsing.tags_normalization: original '.' separators rendered as '/' in CSV for readability

analysis_boundary: Single-cover OCR of a third-party public ranking screenshot. Book/author names and counts are best-effort transcription from an embedded low-resolution table, not verified against the original platform; several glyphs flagged medium remain ambiguous. This cover lacks a 弹评 column entirely; danping is deliberately empty rather than guessed. Qualitative comment_status is the screenshot author's label, not measured data. Do not treat as official ranking or as read book text. No full text of any work is stored.
